name: Task pipeline
description: Task counts per lifecycle status across linked projects, with Build on ready tasks.

settings.label: Project
settings.help: Leave empty for all linked projects.

settings.label: Task source
settings.help: Each project's config.json task_system unless you override it here.

body.query: query($team: String!, $after: String) { issues(first: 100, after: $after, filter: { team: { key: { eq: $team } } }) { nodes { id identifier title priority url state { id name type } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
query($team: String!) { workflowStates(first: 100, filter: { team: { key: { eq: $team } } }) { nodes { id name type position } } }

query($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { issues(first: 100, after: $after, orderBy: { field: CREATED_AT, direction: ASC }) { nodes { number title url state stateReason } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

query($owner: String!, $number: Int!, $field: String!, $after: String) { repositoryOwner(login: $owner) { ... on ProjectV2Owner { projectV2(number: $number) { id field(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { id options { id name } } } items(first: 100, after: $after) { nodes { id type content { ... on Issue { number title url repository { name } } } fieldValueByName(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } } }
